panels.title: Latest monthly rate
panels.description: Average monthly interest rate (% a.m.) on new free-resource vehicle loans to individuals in the latest reference month in range (SGS 25471).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT arg_max(value, ref_dt)::DOUBLE AS monthly_rate
FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/bacen_vehicle_loan_rate/monthly_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE $__timeFilter(ref_dt::TIMESTAMP)

panels.title: Annualized equivalent
panels.description: Latest monthly rate compounded over 12 months: ((1 + r/100)^12 - 1) × 100, in % a.a.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT arg_max(annualized_rate, ref_dt)::DOUBLE AS annualized_rate
FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/bacen_vehicle_loan_rate/monthly_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE $__timeFilter(ref_dt::TIMESTAMP)

panels.title: Change vs 12 months earlier
panels.description: Latest monthly rate in range minus the rate of the same month one year before, in percentage points (red = more expensive credit).

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT ref_dt, value
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/bacen_vehicle_loan_rate/monthly_parse/*.parquet')
),
l AS (
  SELECT max(ref_dt) AS ref_dt
  FROM d
  WHERE $__timeFilter(ref_dt::TIMESTAMP)
)
SELECT (cur.value - prev.value)::DOUBLE AS yoy_change
FROM l
JOIN d AS cur ON cur.ref_dt = l.ref_dt
JOIN d AS prev ON prev.ref_dt = l.ref_dt - INTERVAL 12 MONTH

panels.title: Range (min / max)
panels.description: Lowest and highest monthly rate (% a.m.) in the selected range.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT min(value)::DOUBLE AS min_rate, max(value)::DOUBLE AS max_rate
FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/bacen_vehicle_loan_rate/monthly_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE $__timeFilter(ref_dt::TIMESTAMP)

panels.title: Latest reference month
panels.description: Most recent reference month in range; SGS publishes this series with a lag of about two months.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT strftime(max(ref_dt), '%Y-%m') AS latest
FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/bacen_vehicle_loan_rate/monthly_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE $__timeFilter(ref_dt::TIMESTAMP)

panels.title: Monthly rate and annualized equivalent
panels.description: Average monthly rate (% a.m., left axis) and its 12-month compounded equivalent (% a.a., right axis) per reference month.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  ref_dt::TIMESTAMP AS time,
  value::DOUBLE AS "Monthly rate",
  annualized_rate::DOUBLE AS "Annualized"
FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/bacen_vehicle_loan_rate/monthly_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE $__timeFilter(ref_dt::TIMESTAMP)
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Month-over-month change
panels.description: Monthly rate minus the previous month's rate, in percentage points (red = increase, green = decrease).

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT ref_dt, value
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/bacen_vehicle_loan_rate/monthly_parse/*.parquet')
)
SELECT
  cur.ref_dt::TIMESTAMP AS time,
  (cur.value - prev.value)::DOUBLE AS "MoM change"
FROM d AS cur
JOIN d AS prev ON prev.ref_dt = cur.ref_dt - INTERVAL 1 MONTH
WHERE $__timeFilter(cur.ref_dt::TIMESTAMP)
ORDER BY time

panels.title: 12-month change
panels.description: Monthly rate minus the rate of the same month one year earlier, in percentage points.

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT ref_dt, value
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/bacen_vehicle_loan_rate/monthly_parse/*.parquet')
)
SELECT
  cur.ref_dt::TIMESTAMP AS time,
  (cur.value - prev.value)::DOUBLE AS "12-month change"
FROM d AS cur
JOIN d AS prev ON prev.ref_dt = cur.ref_dt - INTERVAL 12 MONTH
WHERE $__timeFilter(cur.ref_dt::TIMESTAMP)
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Yearly summary
panels.description: Per calendar year in range: months published, average monthly and annualized rates, monthly min/max and the last monthly rate of the year.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  year(ref_dt)::VARCHAR AS year,
  count(*) AS months,
  avg(value)::DOUBLE AS avg_monthly_rate,
  avg(annualized_rate)::DOUBLE AS avg_annualized_rate,
  min(value)::DOUBLE AS min_monthly_rate,
  max(value)::DOUBLE AS max_monthly_rate,
  arg_max(value, ref_dt)::DOUBLE AS last_monthly_rate
FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/bacen_vehicle_loan_rate/monthly_parse/*.parquet')
WHERE $__timeFilter(ref_dt::TIMESTAMP)
GROUP BY year(ref_dt)
ORDER BY year DESC

panels.title: Monthly values
panels.description: Every reference month in range with the annualized equivalent, month-over-month and 12-month changes (p.p.) and the SGS blocked flag.

targets.rawSql:
WITH d AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/bacen_vehicle_loan_rate/monthly_parse/*.parquet')
)
SELECT
  strftime(cur.ref_dt, '%Y-%m') AS ref_month,
  cur.value::DOUBLE AS monthly_rate,
  cur.annualized_rate::DOUBLE AS annualized_rate,
  (cur.value - mom.value)::DOUBLE AS mom_change,
  (cur.value - yoy.value)::DOUBLE AS yoy_change,
  cur.blocked
FROM d AS cur
LEFT JOIN d AS mom ON mom.ref_dt = cur.ref_dt - INTERVAL 1 MONTH
LEFT JOIN d AS yoy ON yoy.ref_dt = cur.ref_dt - INTERVAL 12 MONTH
WHERE $__timeFilter(cur.ref_dt::TIMESTAMP)
ORDER BY cur.ref_dt DESC
